summary: This project explores how astronauts survive and perform daily activities in space. It focuses on four main aspects: eating, sleeping, exercising and living in zero gravity. Students will learn about the challenges astronauts face in space. The project also introduces the special equipment and techniques used to help astronauts stay healthy and safe. It aims to increase students' interest in space science and exploration.
details: The project is presented through an educational infographic poster. It explains how astronauts eat specially prepared food, sleep in sleeping bags and exercise using special equipment. It also shows how astronauts use Velcro and straps to keep objects from floating away. Simple illustrations and descriptions help students understand life in a microgravity environment. The poster is designed to make learning about space fun, easy and interesting for lower secondary students.
